full_prompt_en: A square oil-painted bust portrait shows a blonde woman in a deep red blouse against an abstract field of cream, pale blue, and warm ochre. The background is assembled from broad scraped patches and exposed underlayers, with darker brown blocks near the upper right and a few rough marks along the edges. Her head occupies the center-left, tilted slightly upward and turned toward the viewer. Short tousled blonde hair sweeps over the forehead and around the ears in thick, pale strokes, leaving warm brown shadow at the roots. The eyes are dark and directly attentive, with softly modeled lids and brows; the nose and parted rose-colored lips are rendered more smoothly than the paint around them. Warm peach, coral, and tan tones build her face, neck, and visible upper chest. A vivid crimson blouse with short sleeves and a low open neckline fills the lower part of the image, its folds marked by dark burgundy and almost black strokes. The fabric edges break into rough brushwork at the shoulders rather than forming a polished cutout. Behind the figure, pale blue areas open around the head, and vertical scratches and rectangular sweeps make the flat setting visibly worked. The lower edge crops the torso abruptly, keeping the attention on expression, color, and texture. Light comes from the upper left and front, catching the forehead, cheek, collarbone, and strands of hair, while the underchin and folds of the blouse deepen into warm shadow. The overall composition balances the luminous face and intense red clothing against a pale, heavily worked ground, combining direct presence with energetic, unfinished-looking paint.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形油画半身肖像描绘一位金发女子，穿深红上衣，背后是奶油色、浅蓝和暖赭色的抽象色域。背景由宽阔刮擦色块与露出的底层构成，右上有较深褐色块，边缘带少量粗糙痕迹。头部位于中央偏左，略微仰起并转向观者。蓬松短金发以厚实浅色笔触扫过额头、围住耳朵，发根留下暖褐阴影。深色眼睛直接凝望，眼睑与眉毛塑形柔和；鼻子与微张的玫瑰色嘴唇比周围颜料更平滑。暖桃、珊瑚与棕褐色建立面庞、脖颈和露出的上胸。鲜艳深红上衣有短袖和低而敞开的领口，占据画面下部，褶皱由深酒红与近黑色笔触标出。肩部布料边缘碎成粗笔，而非抛光般整齐的剪影。人物背后，浅蓝色块在头周围敞开，纵向划痕与矩形扫笔让平坦背景显示出加工痕迹。下缘突然裁断身体，使注意力留在神情、色彩和肌理上。光从左上与前方照来，照亮额头、面颊、锁骨与发丝，颏下及上衣褶皱则沉入暖影。整体构图以发亮面庞和强烈红衣对照浅色、重加工的底面，把直接存在感与活跃、近乎未完成的颜料结合。
style_prompt_en: The image has a bold oil-painted surface of dragged strokes, scraped patches, and exposed layers. Broad cream and pale blue fields leave room around a compact, saturated crimson mass, while ochre and brown marks roughen the lighter areas. Focal planes are modeled with comparatively smooth warm half-tones; surrounding edges fracture into thick bristle texture and intermittent dark cuts. Illumination is warm from above and in front, placing compact highlights on upper forms and deeper color in lower folds. The contrast between refined local modeling and visibly worked background gives the image its tension. The overall effect is immediate, tactile, and expressive, with a simple light-dark structure carrying abundant paint activity.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有由拖曳笔触、刮擦色块和露出底层组成的大胆油画表面。宽阔奶油与浅蓝色域在紧凑、饱和的深红体块周围留出空间，赭黄和褐色笔迹使浅色区域粗粝。焦点平面以相对平滑的暖色中间调塑形；周边边缘则碎裂成厚重硬毛笔肌理和间断深色切口。暖光从上方及前方照来，在上表面留下紧凑高光，下方褶曲中颜色更深。精细局部塑形与明显加工的背景形成张力。整体效果直接、可触而富表现力，简单明暗结构承载丰沛颜料活动。
theme_en: A blonde woman in a red blouse against a scraped cream and blue background
theme_zh: 金发女子穿红色上衣，身后是刮擦的奶油与蓝色背景
name: Kathryn Morris Trotter
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
